patterns.note: Alternating full-width background sections with a consistent centered content container, creating clear visual breaks between different content blocks.
Prominent use of a classic serif display font for major headings, contrasted with a modern sans-serif for body text and a monospace font for code examples and technical UI elements.
A vibrant teal green serves as the primary accent color, providing strong contrast against a light background, complemented by a secondary reddish-brown accent for specific highlights.

Initial page load animations include a subtle underline reveal for hero text and a 'typing' effect within terminal window mockups, but no scroll-triggered section reveals or parallax effects are observed.
Technical feature explanations are consistently paired with realistic terminal window mockups, serving as a visual anchor and interactive demonstration of the command-line interface.

technique_notes: Initial load animations for specific text elements and terminal content are achieved using CSS keyframes, creating a dynamic first impression without relying on scroll-triggered effects.
Content is presented within a fixed-width, horizontally centered container, while background colors span the full viewport width, creating clear visual separation between sections.
Interactive code examples are embedded within stylized terminal window components, providing a realistic and engaging demonstration of the product's CLI interface.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for key messages, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and a distinct monospace for code examples.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, cards, and terminal windows, maintaining a soft but not overly playful character.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within feature grids, creating an airy feel in the hero and a structured density in feature lists.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a classic, elegant serif typeface for major headings with a modern, technical monospace font for code and UI elements creates a unique aesthetic. The integrated, animated terminal window mockups are a strong visual motif that effectively communicates the product's technical nature.
